title: German-Style Roasted Pork Chops
description: Tender and juicy pork chops roasted to perfection with a blend of traditional German spices, perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Rinse the pork chops and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried thyme.
Brush the pork chops with olive oil and sprinkle the spice mixture evenly over both sides.
Place the pork chops on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
While the pork chops are roasting, mix together brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of water to make a glaze.
After 15 minutes of roasting, brush the glaze over the pork chops.
Continue roasting for an additional 5-10 minutes or until the glaze is caramelized and the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pork chops from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
